description: The one ordinal scale every confidence axis grades on, lowest first. The order of the terms is the order of the scale: a rule clause `axis>=medium` holds for medium and high.
name: confidence_level

terms.description: Nothing to go on: no claim, no plan, no ranking.
terms.label: None

terms.description: Some basis, but thin: one agent's suggestion, or an unranked placement.
terms.label: Low

terms.description: A reasonable basis that is not yet affirmed: a suggestion with a conversation behind it, or a ranked epic with an open choice.
terms.label: Medium

terms.description: Affirmed, ranked, or concrete: a human has stood behind it.
terms.label: High
